name: apostl-skills
description: Public Apostl agent skills for SDK onboarding and agent-native product readiness.

scripts.skillify: tmpdir=$(mktemp -d); rsync -a --exclude .git ./ "$tmpdir/apostl-skillify-check/"; cd "$tmpdir/apostl-skillify-check" && gbrain skillify check skills/sdk-onboarding-audit/scripts/run_sdk_onboarding_audit.py && gbrain skillify check skills/agent-native-experience/scripts/audit.py; rc=$?; rm -r "$tmpdir"; exit $rc
scripts.test:agent-native: python3 -m unittest discover -s skills/agent-native-experience/tests -v && node --test test/agent-native-experience.test.mjs test/e2e/agent-native-experience-smoke.test.mjs
